translations.literal: Second, one should consult ancient institutions and establish a recommendation examination, ordering those of third rank and below each to recommend those they know; if talent is obtained they receive reward, if false they receive punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Second, the court should consult ancient practice and establish a recommendation examination, requiring officials of third rank and below each to recommend those they know; success brings reward, false recommendation brings punishment.

sentences.zh: 三曰，古者刺史入為三公，郎官出宰百里，蓋使外職識朝廷治體，內官知民間利病。

translations.literal: Third, in antiquity prefects entered office as the Three Dukes, and court gentlemen went out to govern a hundred li—this was to let outer offices know the court's governing body and inner offices know the people's benefit and harm.
translations.idiomatic: Third, in antiquity regional prefects rose to become the Three Dukes, and court gentlemen went out to govern counties—so that local officials would understand how the court governed and central officials would know the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 今後歷縣尹有能聲善政者受郎官御史，歷郡守有奇才異績者任憲使尚書，其餘各驗資品通遷，在內者不得三考連任京官，在外者須歷兩任，乃遷內職。

translations.literal: Henceforth those who served as county magistrate with ability and good governance should receive court gentleman or censor posts; those who served as prefect with extraordinary talent and achievements should be appointed censor-in-chief or minister; the rest should each be verified by qualification for general transfer; those within may not hold metropolitan posts for three consecutive evaluations; those outside must serve two terms before transfer to inner posts.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth county magistrates of proven ability should be promoted to court gentleman or censor; prefects of exceptional achievement should be appointed censor-in-chief or minister; the rest should advance by verified qualification; metropolitan officials may not hold capital posts for three consecutive evaluations; provincial officials must complete two terms before transfer to central posts.

sentences.zh: 績非出類、守不敗官者，則循以年勞，處以常調。

translations.literal: Those whose achievements were not outstanding and whose governance did not fail should then follow seniority and be placed in regular rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Officials whose achievements were not outstanding and who did not fail in office should advance by seniority through regular rotation.

sentences.zh: 凡朝缺官員，須二十月之上，方許遷除。」

translations.literal: For all metropolitan vacancies, more than twenty months must pass before transfer and appointment are permitted."
translations.idiomatic: All metropolitan vacancies must remain open for at least twenty months before appointment."

sentences.zh: 帝可其奏，命中書議行之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his memorial and ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate and carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his memorial and ordered the Central Secretariat to deliberate and implement it.

sentences.zh: 時有官居喪者，往往奪情起復，思謙言：「三年之喪，謂之達禮，自非金革，不可從權。」

translations.literal: At the time officials in mourning often had their grief seized and were recalled to office; Siqian said, "The three-year mourning is called the comprehensive rite; except for war one may not follow expedients."
translations.idiomatic: At the time officials in mourning were often recalled prematurely; Siqian said, "The three-year mourning is the comprehensive rite; except in time of war one may not set it aside by expedient."

sentences.zh: 遂著於令。

translations.literal: This was then written into regulations.
translations.idiomatic: This was then written into law.

sentences.zh: 有詔起報嚴寺。

translations.literal: An edict ordered reconstruction of Baoyan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered reconstruction of Baoyan Temple.

sentences.zh: 思謙曰：「兵荒之餘，當罷土木，以紓民力。」

translations.literal: Siqian said, "In the aftermath of war and famine, construction should be halted to relieve the people's strength."
translations.idiomatic: Siqian said, "In the aftermath of war and famine, construction projects should be halted to relieve the people's burdens."

sentences.zh: 帝嘉之曰：「此正得祖宗立台憲之意。

translations.literal: The emperor praised him, saying, "This truly captures the intent of the ancestors in establishing the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised him, saying, "This truly captures the intent of the ancestors in establishing the censorate.

sentences.zh: 繼此事有當言者，無隱。」

translations.literal: If hereafter there is something that should be spoken, do not conceal it."
translations.idiomatic: If hereafter there is something that should be said, speak without concealment."

sentences.zh: 賜縑綺旌之。

translations.literal: He was granted silk gauze as commendation.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted silk gauze in commendation.

sentences.zh: 未幾，遷右司都事。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to Chief Clerk of the Right Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was transferred to Chief Clerk of the Right Bureau.

sentences.zh: 元統二年五月，轉兵部郎中。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuantong he was transferred to Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Yuantong he was transferred to Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月，改御史臺都事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he was changed to Chief Clerk of the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was transferred to Chief Clerk of the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 重紀至元元年五月，出為淮西道廉訪副使，至淮未期月，引疾歸。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year of Chongji Zhiyuan he went out as Vice Censor of the Huaixi Circuit; he reached Huai and before a month had passed cited illness and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of Chongji Zhiyuan he was posted as Vice Censor of the Huaixi Circuit; he reached Huai but before a month had passed cited illness and returned.

sentences.zh: 六月，召為中書省員外郎，上言：「強盜但傷事主者，皆得死罪，而故殺從而加功之人，與鬥而殺人者，例杖一百七下，得不死，與私宰牛馬之罪無異，是視人與牛馬等也，法應加重。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he was summoned as Outer Director of the Central Secretariat and memorialized, saying, "Robbers who merely injure the victim all receive the death penalty, yet those who deliberately kill followers who add merit, and those who kill in brawling, by statute receive one hundred and seven strokes of the cane and escape death—no different from the crime of privately slaughtering cattle and horses; this treats people equal to cattle and horses; the law should be strengthened.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he was summoned as Outer Director of the Central Secretariat and memorialized, saying, "Robbers who merely injure their victims all receive the death penalty, yet those who deliberately kill accomplices who aided them, and those who kill in brawling, by statute receive one hundred and seven strokes of the cane and escape death—no different from the crime of privately slaughtering cattle and horses; this treats human life as equal to livestock; the law should be strengthened.

sentences.zh: 因姦殺夫，所

translations.literal: For killing a husband through adultery, the
translations.idiomatic: For killing a husband through adultery, the

sentences.zh: 姦妻妾同罪，律有明文，今止坐所犯，似失推明。」

translations.literal: adulterer and wife or concubine share the same guilt; the code has explicit text, yet now only the actual offender is punished, which seems to fail to extend the principle."
translations.idiomatic: adulterer and the wife or concubine share the same guilt; the code states this explicitly, yet now only the principal offender is punished, which seems to fail to apply the principle fully."

sentences.zh: 遂令法曹議，著為定制。

translations.literal: The Legal Bureau was ordered to deliberate and this was written as a fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: The Legal Bureau was ordered to deliberate, and this was enacted as a fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 至正元年，轉兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizheng he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhizheng he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 俄丁內艱，服除，召為右司郎中。

translations.literal: Soon he encountered inner mourning; when mourning ended he was summoned as Director of the Right Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he encountered inner mourning; when mourning ended he was summoned as Director of the Right Bureau.

sentences.zh: 歲凶，盜賊蜂起，剽掠州邑，思謙力言於執政，當竭府庫以賑貧民，分兵鎮撫中夏，以防後患。

translations.literal: In a year of famine bandits rose like bees and plundered prefectures and districts; Siqian strongly told those in power they should exhaust the treasuries to relieve the poor and divide troops to pacify central China against later troubles.
translations.idiomatic: In a famine year bandits rose everywhere and plundered towns; Siqian urgently told those in power to exhaust the treasuries to relieve the poor and deploy troops to pacify central China against future troubles.

sentences.zh: 五年，參議中書省事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was Councilor of Central Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed Councilor of Central Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 轉刑部尚書，改湖南廉訪使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Punishments and changed to Vice Censor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Minister of Punishments and then to Vice Censor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷淮東宣慰司都元帥。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner and Commander-in-Chief of the Huaidong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was transferred to Pacification Commissioner and Commander-in-Chief of the Huaidong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 九年，遷浙西廉訪使、湖廣行中書省參知政事，辭。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was transferred to Vice Censor of Zhexi and Vice Administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, but declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was transferred to Vice Censor of Zhexi and Vice Administrator of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, but declined.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改淮西廉訪使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was changed to Vice Censor of Huaixi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Vice Censor of Huaixi.

sentences.zh: 廬州盜起，思謙亟命廬州路總管杭州不花領弓兵捕之，而賊已不可撲滅矣。

translations.literal: Bandits rose in Luzhou; Siqian urgently ordered the Luzhou Circuit General Administrator Hangzhou Buhua to lead bow troops to capture them, but the bandits could no longer be extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Luzhou; Siqian urgently ordered the Luzhou General Administrator Hangzhou Buhua to lead bow troops against them, but the bandits could no longer be suppressed.

sentences.zh: 言於宣讓王帖木兒不花曰：「承平日久，民不知兵，王以帝室之冑，鎮撫淮甸，豈得坐視！

translations.literal: He said to the Prince of Xuanrang Temür Buhua, "Peace has lasted long and the people know nothing of war; Your Highness, as imperial clansman, pacifies the Huai region—how can you sit and watch!
translations.idiomatic: He said to Prince Xuanrang Temür Buhua, "Peace has lasted so long that the people know nothing of war; Your Highness, as a member of the imperial clan charged with pacifying the Huai region, how can you sit and watch!

sentences.zh: 思謙願與王戮力殄滅。

translations.literal: Siqian wishes to join Your Highness in united effort to exterminate them.
translations.idiomatic: Siqian wishes to join Your Highness in united effort to destroy them.

sentences.zh: 且王府屬怯薛人等，數亦不少，必有能摧鋒陷陣者，惟王圖之。」

translations.literal: Moreover the prince's household keshig and others are not few in number—there must be those able to break the enemy line; it is for Your Highness to plan."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the prince's household keshig and attendants are numerous—there must be men able to break the enemy's line; this is for Your Highness to decide."

sentences.zh: 王曰：「此吾責也，但鞍馬器械未備，何能禦敵？」

translations.literal: The prince said, "This is my responsibility, but saddles, horses, and weapons are not prepared—how can we resist the enemy?"
translations.idiomatic: The prince said, "This is my responsibility, but saddles, horses, and weapons are not ready—how can we face the enemy?"

sentences.zh: 思謙括官民馬，置兵甲，不日而集，分道並進，遂禽渠賊，廬州平。

translations.literal: Siqian collected government and private horses, prepared arms and armor, and in no days assembled them; they advanced by separate routes and captured the ringleader bandits, and Luzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Siqian collected government and private horses, prepared arms and armor, and within days assembled a force; advancing by separate routes they captured the ringleader bandits and pacified Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 既而潁寇將渡淮，又言於王曰：「潁寇東侵，亟調芍陂屯卒用之。」

translations.literal: Thereafter Ying bandits were about to cross the Huai; he again said to the prince, "The Ying bandits invade eastward—urgently mobilize the garrison troops at Shaobo Pond for use."
translations.idiomatic: When Ying bandits were about to cross the Huai, he again said to the prince, "The Ying bandits are advancing eastward—urgently mobilize the garrison troops at Shaobo Pond."

sentences.zh: 王曰：「非奉詔，不敢調。」

translations.literal: The prince said, "Without imperial edict I dare not mobilize."
translations.idiomatic: The prince said, "Without an imperial edict I dare not mobilize them."

sentences.zh: 思謙言：「非常之變，理宜從權，擅發之罪，思謙坐之。」

translations.literal: Siqian said, "In extraordinary change reason permits following expedient; the crime of unauthorized mobilization—Siqian will bear it."
translations.idiomatic: Siqian said, "In extraordinary circumstances reason permits expedient action; if unauthorized mobilization is a crime, Siqian will bear it."

sentences.zh: 王感其言，從之。

translations.literal: The prince was moved by his words and followed him.
translations.idiomatic: The prince was moved by his words and agreed.

sentences.zh: 其侄立本為屯田萬戶，召語曰：「吾祖宗以忠義傳家，汝之職，乃我先人力戰所致，今國家有難，汝當身先士卒，以圖報效，庶無負朝廷也。」

translations.literal: His nephew Liben was Wanhu of military colonies; he summoned and told him, "Our ancestors transmitted loyalty and righteousness through the family; your post was won by my forebears' hard fighting; now the state has difficulty—you should lead the troops in person to seek repayment of service, lest you fail the court."
translations.idiomatic: His nephew Liben was Wanhu of military colonies; he summoned him and said, "Our ancestors transmitted loyalty and righteousness through the family; your post was won by my forebears' hard fighting; now the state is in crisis—you should lead the troops in person to repay your service, lest you fail the court."

sentences.zh: 尋召入，為集賢侍講學士，修定國律。

translations.literal: Soon he was recalled and made Academician Lecturer of the Hall of Gathered Talents, revising and fixing the national code.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was recalled as Academician Lecturer of the Hall of Gathered Talents to revise the national code.

sentences.zh: 十二年，拜治書侍御史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was appointed Secretariat Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was appointed Secretariat Censor.

sentences.zh: 明年，升中丞，年近七十，上章乞老，不允，特旨進一品，授榮祿大夫，仍御史中丞。

translations.literal: The next year he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief; nearing seventy he memorialized requesting retirement, but it was not granted; by special edict he was advanced one rank, granted Honored Grand Master, and remained Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief; nearing seventy he memorialized for retirement but was refused; by special edict he was advanced one rank, granted Honored Grand Master, and remained Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 入謝，感疾，及命下，強拜受命，明日卒。

translations.literal: Entering to give thanks he fell ill; when the order came down he forced himself to bow and accept appointment, and the next day died.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to give thanks but fell ill; when the appointment arrived he forced himself to bow and accept it, and died the next day.

sentences.zh: 贈宣猷秉憲佐治功臣、翰林學士承旨、榮祿大夫、柱國，追封魯國公，諡通敏。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the title Meritorious Minister Assisting Governance with Upright Counsel, Hanlin Academician Exemplar, Honored Grand Master, and Pillar of the State, enfeoffed as Duke of Lu, with posthumous title Tongmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Meritorious Minister Assisting Governance with Upright Counsel, Hanlin Academician Exemplar, Honored Grand Master, and Pillar of the State, enfeoffed as Duke of Lu, with the posthumous epithet Tongmin.

sentences.zh: ○韓元善

translations.literal: ○ Han Yuanshan
translations.idiomatic: ○ Han Yuanshan

sentences.zh: 韓元善，字大雅，汴梁之太康人。

translations.literal: Han Yuanshan, styled Daya, was a man of Taikang in Bianliang.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yuanshan, styled Daya, was a native of Taikang in Bianliang.

sentences.zh: 唐檢校司空贈司徒充，以宣武軍節度使兼統義成軍，留鎮汴，子孫遂為太康韓氏。

translations.literal: Tang Acting Minister of Works posthumously granted Minister of Works Han Chong, as Military Commissioner of the Xuanwu Army concurrently commanding the Yicheng Army, remained to garrison Bian; his descendants thus became the Han clan of Taikang.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang Acting Minister of Works posthumously granted Minister of Works Han Chong, as Military Commissioner of the Xuanwu Army while also commanding the Yicheng Army, remained to garrison Bian; his descendants thus became the Han clan of Taikang.

sentences.zh: 父克昌，至大間仕為監察御史，以論事有名聲。

translations.literal: His father Kechang, in the Zhide period served as Investigating Censor and was renowned for discussing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His father Kechang served as Investigating Censor during the Zhide period and was renowned for his forthright memorials.

sentences.zh: 元善由國子監生積分中程，釋褐，除新州判官，累擢江南行台監察御史，歷中書左司郎中、吏部侍郎、吏部尚書、僉樞密院事。

translations.literal: Yuanshan through Guozijian student accumulated points and passed the examination, doffed his robe, was appointed Assistant Prefect of Xinzhou, and was repeatedly promoted to Investigating Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, serving as Director of the Left Bureau of the Central Secretariat, Vice Minister of Personnel, Minister of Personnel, and Vice Minister of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshan passed the Guozijian examination, entered office as Assistant Prefect of Xinzhou, and rose through successive appointments to Investigating Censor of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate, Director of the Left Bureau of the Central Secretariat, Vice Minister of Personnel, Minister of Personnel, and Vice Minister of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 至正三年，拜中書參知政事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhizheng he was appointed Vice Administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhizheng he was appointed Vice Administrator of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五年，遷大司農卿，尋出為江南行御史臺中丞、燕南肅政廉訪使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to Director of the Directorate of Agriculture, then went out as Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate and Purifying Censor of the Yannan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to Director of the Directorate of Agriculture, then posted out as Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan Branch Censorate and Purifying Censor of the Yannan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 九年，召拜中書左丞、同知經筵事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was summoned and appointed Left Vice Administrator of the Central Secretariat and Associate Commissioner of the Classics Collegium.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was summoned as Left Vice Administrator of the Central Secretariat and Associate Commissioner of the Classics Collegium.

sentences.zh: 十一年，丞相脫脫奏事內廷，以事關兵機，而元善及參知政事韓鏞皆漢人，使退避，勿與俱，由是遂與右丞玉樞虎兒吐華同分省彰德以給饋餉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Chancellor Toghto reported affairs in the inner court; because matters concerned military secrets and Yuanshan and Vice Administrator Han Yong were both Han Chinese, they were made to withdraw and not attend together; thereby he with Right Vice Administrator Yushu Qurtughua divided the province at Zhangde to supply provisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Chancellor Toghto reported affairs in the inner court; because matters concerned military secrets and Yuanshan and Vice Administrator Han Yong were Han Chinese, they were ordered to withdraw and not attend; he was therefore assigned with Right Vice Administrator Yushu Qurtughua to divide the province at Zhangde to supply provisions.

sentences.zh: 十二年，御史大夫也先帖木兒總兵討汝寧，元善至衛輝，以病卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year Censor-in-Chief Yeshan Temür led troops to pacify Runing; Yuanshan reached Weihui and died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Censor-in-Chief Yeshan Temür led troops against Runing; Yuanshan reached Weihui and died of illness.

sentences.zh: 元善性純正，明達政體，揚歷臺閣三十餘年，遂躋丞轄，以文學治才，羽翼廟謨，論議之際，秉義陳法，不偭鄉上官，國是所在，倚之以為重。

translations.literal: Yuanshan was pure and upright by nature, clear in governmental institutions; promoted through censorate and secretariat more than thirty years, he then reached vice chancellorship; with literary learning and administrative talent he aided court deliberations; in discussion he upheld righteousness and stated law, not bending to superiors or colleagues; wherever state policy lay, the court relied on him as weighty.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshan was pure and upright by nature and clear in governmental institutions; over more than thirty years in the censorate and secretariat he rose to vice chancellorship; with literary learning and administrative talent he aided court deliberations; in debate he upheld righteousness and cited law, never bending to superiors; on matters of state policy the court relied on him heavily.

sentences.zh: 嘗以謁告侍親居家，效範文正公遺規，置田百畝為義莊，以周貧族。

translations.literal: Once when on leave to serve his parents at home he followed Fan Zhongyan's legacy regulation, setting aside a hundred mu of fields as a charity estate to relieve poor clansmen.
translations.idiomatic: Once while on leave serving his parents at home he followed Fan Zhongyan's charitable estate model, setting aside a hundred mu of fields to relieve poor clansmen.

sentences.zh: 至正交鈔初行，賜近臣各三百錠，元善復以買田六百畝，為義塾，延名士​​，以教族人子弟云。

translations.literal: When the Zhizheng paper notes were first issued, close ministers were each granted three hundred ding; Yuanshan again used them to buy six hundred mu of fields as a charity school, inviting renowned scholars to teach the sons and younger brothers of the clan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhizheng paper notes were first issued, close ministers were each granted three hundred ding; Yuanshan used his grant to buy six hundred mu of fields for a charity school, inviting renowned scholars to teach the clan's younger generation.

sentences.zh: ○崔敬

translations.literal: ○ Cui Jing
translations.idiomatic: ○ Cui Jing

sentences.zh: 崔敬，字伯恭，大寧之惠州人。

translations.literal: Cui Jing, styled Bogong, was a man of Huizhou in Daning.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Jing, styled Bogong, was a native of Huizhou in Daning.

sentences.zh: 通刑名法律之學。

translations.literal: He mastered the learning of penal names and laws.
translations.idiomatic: He mastered penal law and legal studies.

sentences.zh: 淮東、山南廉訪司皆辟書吏。

translations.literal: The Huaidong and Shannan Purifying Censorates both recruited him as a clerk.
translations.idiomatic: The Huaidong and Shannan Purifying Censorates both recruited him as a clerk.

sentences.zh: 天歷初，辟御史臺察院書吏，歷刑部令史、徽政院掾史，遂升中書掾。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianli he was recruited as clerk of the Censorate Inspection Bureau, served as Clerk of the Ministry of Punishments and Clerk of the Imperial Entertainment Commission, then was promoted to Clerk of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianli reign he was recruited as clerk of the Censorate Inspection Bureau, served as Clerk of the Ministry of Punishments and the Imperial Entertainment Commission, then rose to Clerk of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 至元五年，用累考及格，授刑部主事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan, through accumulated examinations passing grade, he was appointed Clerk of the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan, having passed accumulated examinations, he was appointed Clerk of the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷樞密院都事，拜監察御史。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Chief Clerk of the Bureau of Military Affairs and appointed Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to Chief Clerk of the Bureau of Military Affairs and appointed Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 時既毀文宗廟主，削文宗後皇太后之號，徙東安州，而皇弟燕帖古思，文宗子也，又放之高麗。

translations.literal: At the time the temple tablets of Emperor Wenzong had already been destroyed, the posthumous title of Wenzong's empress dowager was stripped, and she was moved to Dong'anzhou; moreover the emperor's younger brother Yantugh, Wenzong's son, was also sent away to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Emperor Wenzong's temple tablets had been destroyed, the posthumous title of Wenzong's empress dowager was stripped, and she was moved to Dong'anzhou; moreover the emperor's younger brother Yantugh, Wenzong's son, was also banished to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 敬上疏，略曰：「文皇獲不軌之愆，已徹廟祀；

translations.literal: Jing memorialized, saying in summary, "Emperor Wen incurred the fault of improper conduct and his temple worship was already removed;
translations.idiomatic: Jing memorialized, saying in summary, "Emperor Wen incurred improper conduct and his temple worship was already removed;

sentences.zh: 叔母有階禍之罪，亦削洪名。

translations.literal: the empress dowager incurred the crime of bringing disaster by steps and her great title was also stripped.
translations.idiomatic: the empress dowager incurred the crime of bringing disaster by steps and her great title was also stripped.

sentences.zh: 盡孝正名，斯亦足矣。

translations.literal: To fulfill filial piety and rectify names—this is already sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: To fulfill filial piety and rectify names is already sufficient.

sentences.zh: 惟念皇弟燕帖古思太子，年方在幼，罹此播遷，天理人情，有所不忍。

translations.literal: Only consider the emperor's younger brother, Crown Prince Yantugh, still young, suffering this displacement—the principle of heaven and human feeling cannot bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Only consider the emperor's younger brother, Crown Prince Yantugh, still young, suffering this displacement—heaven's principle and human feeling cannot bear it.

sentences.zh: 明皇當上賓之日，太子在襁褓之間，尚未有知，義當矜憫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Ming departed, the crown prince was still in swaddling clothes and had no knowledge; righteousness demands pity.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming departed, the crown prince was still in swaddling clothes and had no knowledge; justice demands compassion.

sentences.zh: 蓋武宗視明、文二帝，皆親子也，陛下與太子，皆嫡孫也。

translations.literal: For Emperor Wuzong regarded Emperors Ming and Wen both as his own sons; Your Majesty and the crown prince are both legitimate grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong regarded Emperors Ming and Wen both as his own sons; Your Majesty and the crown prince are both legitimate grandsons.

sentences.zh: 以武皇之心為心，則皆子孫，固無親疏；

translations.literal: With Emperor Wuzong's heart as heart, then all are descendants and naturally there is no near and far;
translations.idiomatic: With Emperor Wuzong's heart as heart, all are descendants and naturally there is no near and far;

sentences.zh: 以陛下之心為心，未免有彼此之論。

translations.literal: with Your Majesty's heart as heart, one cannot avoid the discussion of this and that.
translations.idiomatic: with Your Majesty's heart as heart, one cannot avoid the discussion of insider and outsider.

sentences.zh: 臣請以世俗喻之：常人有百金之產，尚置義田，宗族困厄者，為之教養，不使失所。

translations.literal: Your servant asks to use a worldly comparison: a common man with a hundred-cash estate still sets up a charity field so that clansmen in distress may be taught and nourished and not lose their place.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant asks to use a worldly comparison: a common man with a modest estate still sets up a charity field so that distressed clansmen may be taught and nourished and not lose their place.

sentences.zh: 況皇上貴為天子，富有四海，子育黎元，當使一夫一婦無不得其所，今乃以同氣之人，置之度外，適足貽笑邊邦，取辱外國。

translations.literal: How much more for Your Majesty, noble as Son of Heaven, rich with the four seas, nurturing the black-haired people—should make it so that not one man or woman fails to obtain their place; now to place one of the same breath outside consideration suffices to invite laughter from border states and bring shame from foreign countries.
translations.idiomatic: How much more for Your Majesty, noble as Son of Heaven, rich with the four seas, nurturing all the people—should ensure that not one man or woman fails to obtain their place; now to set aside one of the same breath invites laughter from border states and shame from foreign countries.

sentences.zh: 況蠻夷之心，不可測度，倘生他變，關係非輕。

translations.literal: Moreover the hearts of barbarians cannot be measured; if another change should arise the relation is not light.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover barbarian hearts cannot be measured; if another change should arise the consequences are grave.

sentences.zh: 興言至此，良為寒心！

translations.literal: Speaking to this point, one is truly chilled at heart!
translations.idiomatic: To speak to this point chills the heart!

sentences.zh: 臣願殺身以贖太子之罪，望陛下遣近臣迎歸太后、太子，以全母子之情，盡骨肉之義，天意回，人心悅，則宗社幸甚！」

translations.literal: Your servant wishes to kill himself to redeem the crown prince's crime; I hope Your Majesty will send a close minister to welcome back the empress dowager and crown prince, to complete mother-son affection and fulfill flesh-and-blood duty; if heaven's intent turns and people's hearts rejoice, then the altars of soil and grain are greatly fortunate!"
translations.idiomatic: Your servant wishes to offer his life to redeem the crown prince's crime; I hope Your Majesty will send a close minister to welcome back the empress dowager and crown prince, to complete mother-son affection and flesh-and-blood duty; if heaven's intent turns and hearts rejoice, the altars of soil and grain will be greatly blessed!"

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: There was no reply.
translations.idiomatic: There was no reply.

sentences.zh: 又上疏，諫天子巡幸上都，宜禦內殿。

translations.literal: He again memorialized, remonstrating that the Son of Heaven on touring the Upper Capital should dwell in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: He again memorialized, remonstrating that the Son of Heaven on touring the Upper Capital should dwell in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 其略曰：「世祖以上都為清暑之地，車駕行幸，歲以為常，閣有大安，殿有鴻禧、睿思，所以保養聖躬，適起居之宜，存畏敬之心也。

translations.literal: In summary he said, "Shizu took the Upper Capital as a place to escape summer heat; the imperial carriage traveled there yearly as constant; the pavilion had Great Peace, the halls Hongxi and Ruisi, to preserve the sage body, suit the rhythm of rising and resting, and keep a heart of reverent caution.
translations.idiomatic: In summary he said, "Kublai Khan took the Upper Capital as a summer retreat; the imperial carriage traveled there yearly as a matter of course; the pavilion had Great Peace, the halls Hongxi and Ruisi, to preserve the sage body, suit the rhythm of rising and resting, and keep a heart of reverent caution.

sentences.zh: 今失剌斡耳朵思，乃先皇所以備宴遊，非常時臨御之所。

translations.literal: Now the Shalaghor encampment was where the former emperor prepared banquets and travel—not a place for extraordinary times to hold court.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Shalaghor encampment was where the former emperor prepared banquets and excursions—not a place for the emperor to hold court in ordinary times.

sentences.zh: 今陛下方以孝治天下，屢降德音，祗行宗廟親祀之禮，雖動植無知，罔不歡悅，而國家多故，天道變更，臣備員風紀，以言為職，願大駕還大內，居深宮，嚴宿衛，與宰臣謀治道。

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty governs the realm with filial piety, repeatedly issuing virtuous edicts, reverently performing the ancestral temples' personal sacrifice rites; though moving plants and animals without knowledge, none fail to rejoice—yet the state has many troubles and heaven's way changes; your servant fills a post in discipline and takes speech as duty; I wish the great carriage would return to the great inner city, dwell in the deep palace, tighten night guards, and with chancellors discuss the way of governance.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty governs the realm with filial piety, repeatedly issuing virtuous edicts and reverently performing the ancestral temples' personal sacrifice rites; though even plants and animals without understanding cannot fail to rejoice—yet the state has many troubles and heaven's way changes; your servant fills a disciplinary post and takes speech as duty; I wish the great carriage would return to the great inner city, dwell in the deep palace, tighten night guards, and with chancellors discuss the way of governance.

sentences.zh: 萬機之暇，則命經筵進講，究古今盛衰之由，緝熙聖學，乃宗社之福也。」

translations.literal: In leisure from the myriad affairs, then order the Classics Collegium to lecture, investigate the causes of rise and fall through antiquity, brighten sagely learning—this is the fortune of the altars of soil and grain."
translations.idiomatic: In leisure from the myriad affairs, order the Classics Collegium to lecture, investigate the causes of rise and fall through antiquity, and brighten sagely learning—this is the fortune of the altars of soil and grain."

sentences.zh: 時帝數以歷代珍寶分賜近侍，敬又上疏曰：「臣聞世皇時，大臣有功，所賜不過槃革，重惜天物，為後世慮至遠也。

translations.literal: The emperor frequently distributed historical treasures to close attendants; Jing again memorialized, saying, "Your servant has heard that in Shizu's time, when great ministers had merit, what was granted did not exceed leather dishes; he treasured heaven's goods and planned far for posterity.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor frequently distributed historical treasures to close attendants; Jing again memorialized, saying, "Your servant has heard that in Kublai Khan's time, when great ministers had merit, what was granted did not exceed leather vessels; he treasured heaven's goods and planned far ahead for posterity.

sentences.zh: 今山東大饑，燕南亢旱，海潮為災，天文示儆，地道失寧，京畿南北，蝗飛蔽天，正當聖主恤民之日。

translations.literal: Now Shandong suffers great famine, Yan South severe drought, sea tides disaster, astronomy shows warning, earth's way loses tranquility; north and south of the capital locusts fly blotting the sky—this is precisely when the sage ruler should pity the people.
translations.idiomatic: Now Shandong suffers great famine, Yan South severe drought, sea tides bring disaster, astronomy shows warnings, and the earth loses tranquility; north and south of the capital locusts blot the sky—this is precisely when the sage ruler should pity the people.

sentences.zh: 近侍之臣，不知慮此，奏禀承請，殆無虛日，甚至以府庫百年​​所積之寶物，遍賜僕禦閽寺之流、乳稚童孩之子。

translations.literal: Close attendants do not consider this, memorializing and requesting without idle days, even to the point of bestowing treasures accumulated in the treasury for a hundred years throughout on runners, gatekeepers, temple servants, wet nurses, and infant children.
translations.idiomatic: Close attendants do not consider this, memorializing and requesting almost daily, even bestowing treasures accumulated in the treasury for a century on runners, gatekeepers, temple servants, wet nurses, and infant children.

sentences.zh: 帑藏或空，萬一國有大事，人有大功，又將何以為賜乎！

translations.literal: If the treasury is empty, should great affairs arise or a man have great merit, with what will gifts be made!
translations.idiomatic: If the treasury is emptied, should great affairs arise or a man achieve great merit, with what will gifts be made!

sentences.zh: 乞追回所賜，以示恩不可濫，庶允公論。」

translations.literal: I beg to recall what was granted to show favor cannot be excessive, and thereby satisfy public discussion."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that what was granted be recalled to show that favor cannot be lavished indiscriminately, and thereby satisfy public discussion."

sentences.zh: 是年，出僉山北廉訪司事，按部全寧。

translations.literal: That year he went out as Commissioner of the Shanbei Purifying Censorate and inspected Quanning.
translations.idiomatic: That year he was posted as Commissioner of the Shanbei Purifying Censorate and inspected Quanning.

sentences.zh: 獄有李秀，以坐造偽鈔，連數十人，而皆與秀不相識，敬疑而讞之。

translations.literal: In the prison was Li Xiu, convicted of making counterfeit notes, implicating several tens of people who all did not know Xiu; Jing doubted and reinvestigated.
translations.idiomatic: In the prison was Li Xiu, convicted of counterfeiting notes and implicating several dozen people who all did not know him; Jing doubted the case and reinvestigated.

sentences.zh: 秀曰：「吾以訓童子為業，居村落間，有司至秀舍，謂秀為偽造鈔者，捶楚之下，不敢不誣服耳。」

translations.literal: Xiu said, "I take teaching children as my profession and dwell among villages; when officials came to Xiu's house they said Xiu was a counterfeiter; under beating I dared not but falsely confess."
translations.idiomatic: Xiu said, "I make my living teaching children and dwell in a village; when officials came to my house they said I was a counterfeiter; under torture I dared not but falsely confess."

sentences.zh: 敬詢知始謀者，乃大同王濁，十餘年事不洩，而有司誤以李秀為王濁也。

translations.literal: Jing inquired and learned the original plotter was Prince of Datong Wang Zhuo; more than ten years the matter had not leaked, and the authorities mistakenly took Li Xiu for Wang Zhuo.
translations.idiomatic: Jing inquired and learned the original plotter was the Prince of Datong, Wang Zhuo; for more than ten years the matter had not leaked, and the authorities mistakenly took Li Xiu for Wang Zhuo.

sentences.zh: 移文至大同，果得王濁為真造偽鈔者。

translations.literal: He sent documents to Datong and indeed obtained Wang Zhuo as the true counterfeiter.
translations.idiomatic: He sent documents to Datong and indeed obtained Wang Zhuo as the true counterfeiter.

sentences.zh: 至正初，遷河南，又遷江東。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhizheng he was transferred to Henan, then to Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhizheng he was transferred to Henan, then to Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 所至抑豪強，惠下窮，洗冤滯，興學勸農，百廢具舉。

translations.literal: Wherever he went he suppressed powerful families, benefited the poor and weak, cleared wrongful convictions, revived learning and encouraged agriculture, and a hundred neglected tasks were all undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he went he suppressed powerful families, aided the poor and weak, cleared wrongful convictions, revived learning and encouraged agriculture, and undertook a hundred neglected reforms.

sentences.zh: 除江西行省左右司郎中，入為諸路寶鈔提舉，改工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed Director of the Left and Right Bureaus of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, entered office as Commissioner of Treasure Note Transport for all circuits, and was changed to Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Director of the Left and Right Bureaus of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat, entered office as Commissioner of Treasure Note Transport for all circuits, and was transferred to Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十一年，遷同知大都路總管府事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Associate Administrator of the Dadu Circuit General Administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Associate Administrator of the Dadu Circuit General Administration.

sentences.zh: 直沽河淤數年，中書省委敬浚治之，給鈔數万錠，募工萬人，不三月告成，咸服其能。

translations.literal: The Zhigu River had silted for several years; the Central Secretariat entrusted Jing to dredge it, giving several tens of thousands of ding of notes, recruiting ten thousand workers; in less than three months it was completed, and all admired his ability.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhigu River had silted for several years; the Central Secretariat entrusted Jing to dredge it, providing tens of thousands of ding of paper notes and recruiting ten thousand workers; in less than three months the work was completed, and all admired his efficiency.

sentences.zh: 除刑部侍郎，遷中書左司郎中。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Minister of Punishments and transferred to Director of the Left Bureau of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Minister of Punishments and transferred to Director of the Left Bureau of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十二年，歷兵部尚書，為樞密院判官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he served as Minister of Military Affairs and was Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he served as Minister of Military Affairs and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 十四年，遷刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 廣東府憲仇殺，以沙加班處大逆，敬詳憲府以私相害，致有是變，殺人者自有典章，得坐一人，大逆非謀反，則不科得坐一家，敬立論舍重而就輕，朝廷咸以為然。

translations.literal: In Guangdong a prefectural censor was killed in a private feud; by precedent the Saban class was punished for great treason; Jing detailed to the censorate that this was private mutual harm causing the change—the killer has his own statutes and only one person may be punished; great treason is not rebellion and one may not punish an entire family; Jing argued abandoning the heavy for the light, and the court all considered it correct.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangdong a prefectural censor was killed in a private feud; by precedent the Saban class was punished for great treason; Jing argued to the censorate that this was private mutual harm—the killer falls under ordinary statutes and only one person should be punished; great treason applies only to rebellion and does not extend to an entire family; Jing argued for the lighter penalty, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 十五年，復為樞密院判官，尋拜參知政事，行省河南，復為兵部尚書，兼濟寧軍民屯田使。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he again became Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, soon appointed Vice Administrator of the Henan Branch Secretariat, again Minister of Military Affairs, and concurrently Commissioner of Military Colonies for Jining.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he again became Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, soon appointed Vice Administrator of the Henan Branch Secretariat, again Minister of Military Affairs, and concurrently Commissioner of Military Colonies for Jining.

sentences.zh: 朝廷給以鈔十萬錠，散於有司，招致居民、軍士，立營屯種，歲收得百萬斛，以給邊防。

translations.literal: The court gave him one hundred thousand ding of notes to distribute to relevant offices, summon residents and soldiers, establish camps and plant fields; yearly harvest reached a million hu to supply the border defense.
translations.idiomatic: The court gave him one hundred thousand ding of notes to distribute to relevant offices, summon residents and soldiers, and establish military colonies; the yearly harvest reached a million hu to supply border defense.

sentences.zh: 居歲餘，其法井井。

translations.literal: After more than a year the method was orderly in every respect.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year the system was running in perfect order.

sentences.zh: 十有七年，召為大司農少卿，遂拜中書參知政事。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was summoned as Vice Director of the Directorate of Agriculture, then appointed Vice Administrator of the Central Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was summoned as Vice Director of the Directorate of Agriculture, then appointed Vice Administrator of the Central Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 盜據齊魯，敬與平章政事答蘭、參知政事俺普，分省陵州。

translations.literal: Bandits held Qi and Lu; Jing with Vice Administrator Tala and Vice Administrator Emu divided the province at Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits held Qi and Lu; Jing with Vice Administrator Tala and Vice Administrator Emu divided the province at Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 陵州乃南北要衝，無城郭，而居民散處，敬兼領兵、刑、戶、工四部事，供給諸軍，事無不集。

translations.literal: Lingzhou was a vital north-south pass without walls or moats and residents scattered; Jing concurrently oversaw military, punishment, revenue, and works affairs, supplying the various armies—nothing failed to be gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhou was a vital north-south thoroughfare without walls, its residents scattered; Jing concurrently oversaw military, punishment, revenue, and works affairs, supplying all armies—nothing was left wanting.

sentences.zh: 丞相以其能上聞，賜之上尊，仍命其便宜行事。

translations.literal: The chancellor because he could report upward granted him superior wine and still ordered him to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Because he could report effectively to the throne, the chancellor granted him superior wine and authorized him to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 敬與俺普密議曰：「我軍強且勝，彼將敗而降，如得仗義之士，直抵其巢穴而招安之，亦方面之幸也。」

translations.literal: Jing secretly discussed with Emu, saying, "Our army is strong and victorious; they will be defeated and surrender; if we obtain men of righteousness to go straight to their nest and summon them to submission, that too is a regional fortune."
translations.idiomatic: Jing secretly discussed with Emu, saying, "Our army is strong and will prevail; the enemy will be defeated and surrender; if we can find men of principle to go straight to their stronghold and offer submission, that would be a blessing for the region."

sentences.zh: 有國子生王恪等，願請往，敬以便宜授以官，俾之行，至鄆城，見李秉彝、田豐等，諭以逆順禍福之理，豐與秉彝皆悔過自新。

translations.literal: There were Guozijian students Wang Ke and others who wished to go; Jing by discretion granted them office and sent them; reaching Yuncheng they met Li Bingyi, Tian Feng, and others and explained the principle of compliance and defiance, fortune and misfortune; Feng and Bingyi both repented and renewed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Guozijian students Wang Ke and others volunteered to go; Jing granted them office by discretion and sent them; reaching Yuncheng they met Li Bingyi and Tian Feng and explained the logic of compliance and defiance, fortune and misfortune; Feng and Bingyi both repented and submitted.

sentences.zh: 山東郡邑之复，敬之策居多。

translations.literal: In the recovery of Shandong commanderies and districts Jing's strategy counted for the greater part.
translations.idiomatic: In the recovery of Shandong commanderies and districts Jing's strategy counted for much.

sentences.zh: 敬以軍馬供給浩繁，而民力日疲，乃請行納粟補官之令，中書以其言聞，詔從之。

translations.literal: Jing because military horse supply was vast and the people's strength daily exhausted requested implementation of the order to supply grain for purchased office; the Central Secretariat reported his words and an edict followed.
translations.idiomatic: Because military supply was vast and the people's strength daily exhausted, Jing requested implementation of the policy allowing grain purchases in exchange for office; the Central Secretariat reported his proposal and an edict followed.

sentences.zh: 河北燕南士民踵躡而至，積粟百萬石、綺段萬匹，用以給軍費，民獲少蘇。

translations.literal: Scholars and commoners of Hebei and Yan South followed in succession; grain accumulated to a million shi and silk bolts to ten thousand pi, used to supply military expenses, and the people obtained slight relief.
translations.idiomatic: Scholars and commoners of Hebei and Yan South followed in succession; grain accumulated to a million shi and silk to ten thousand bolts, used to supply military expenses, and the people obtained slight relief.

sentences.zh: 十八年，除山東行樞密院副使，俄遷江浙行省左丞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Shandong Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, soon transferred to Left Vice Administrator of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Shandong Branch Bureau of Military Affairs, soon transferred to Left Vice Administrator of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十七。

translations.literal: He died, age sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 贈資善大夫，江浙行省左丞如故，諡曰忠敏。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Master for Assisting Goodness, Left Vice Administrator of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat as before, with posthumous title Zhongmin.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Grand Master for Assisting Goodness, retaining the post of Left Vice Administrator of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat, with the posthumous epithet Zhongmin.
